title: Jeff: The Awoken Core
description: Face Jeff, a late-game raid boss who tests your skill, strategy, and timing to earn powerful loot and master Minecraft combat
body:
Jeff: The Awoken Core

A boss encounter mod built for Fabric 1.21.8

This mod is currently in early testing.
Some mechanics, visuals, and loot systems may change as features may be added or changed.

Feedback and bug reports are welcome — contact me (GunjiCord) in my Discord if you need any help: 

https://discord.gg/ygSYvgXqEs

(If that link doesnt work then there should be one in my youtube bio that does: YT is GunjiCord)



How to help test: 

Make sure you’re in a flat, open area.

Run the command: /summonarena

The fletching table acts as the entry/exit point

Entering will automatically spawn Jeff, The Awoken Core at its center.

You’ll be given three unique shields — Blue, Green, and Red — used to block different types of attacks.
From there you should be able to figure out the rest of the fight :)



Requirements

Fabric Loader 0.17.2 or newer

Minecraft 1.21.8

Fabric API

GeckoLib 5.x
